implementationFacts.depositPointSupportedNodeRule: normalized compact Gaussian weights over the in-radius grid nodes; if no node is in support, assign the full amount to the nearest clamped grid node
implementationFacts.depositSegmentRule: midpoint integration with step <= min(grid pitch)/2, each slice sent through the same brush

firstMoment.theoreticalBoundBasis: maximum distance from a point in a square-grid Voronoi cell to its nearest node; R<h/2 ensures no more than one supported node and fallback uses that same nearest node

straightP00P01.absentDistinction: The complete route is physically translated by half one grid pitch in y, while every ordered dose and x position remains matched; the stored node sequence, Float32 values, support, mass, and centroid are identical, so the y translation cannot be recovered from raster bytes.

informationLossClassification.subcellPositionRetention: SUPPORTED loss: multiple source coordinates share exact one-node Float32 footprints
informationLossClassification.firstMomentRetention: SUPPORTED loss: raster centroid is the nearest node for isolated point deposits; report measured error and grid bound separately
informationLossClassification.localDisplacementResolution: SUPPORTED loss: exact raster remains constant across finite subcell displacement intervals
informationLossClassification.localOrientationRetention: see fixed short-segment orientation comparisons; do not generalize beyond tested lengths
informationLossClassification.phaseEquivariance: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED loss: exact translated route fixture p00/p01 has different source positions but identical raster bytes
informationLossClassification.dosePreservation: separate from spatial fidelity; all route arms are uncapped and requested/accepted amounts are compared to stored Float32 mass
